title: DataHub AI
summary: DataHub AI is a data-focused platform designed to help users discover, understand, assess, clean, and prepare datasets for analysis. It brings dataset management, data quality assessment, preprocessing, and analytics preparation into a structured workflow.
features: Dataset upload and management
Dataset search and categorization
Data dictionary and metadata
Data quality assessment and scoring
Missing-value detection
Duplicate detection
Invalid-value checks
Consistency checks
Smart data cleaning and preprocessing
Prepared dataset export
Workflow toward Power BI, Python, and SQL analysis
subtitle: Dataset Management & Data Quality Assessment Platform

title: At-Risk Student Detection and Performance Monitoring System
summary: A Python-based workflow designed to flag students at academic risk using attendance, grades, and academic performance patterns.
features: Cleaned and validated academic-record datasets, including missing values and formatting inconsistencies.
Built a Python-based machine-learning workflow designed to flag students at risk.
Designed faculty-facing dashboards for viewing attendance, grades, and risk indicators.
Used SQLite for storing and querying student data.

title: Sales Performance Dashboard
summary: Interactive Power BI views for sales, profit, customer performance, and monthly trends, with Power Query transformations and filters.
features: Cleaned and transformed multi-region sales data using Power Query.
Built an interactive Power BI dashboard using KPI cards, trend charts, and analytical visualizations.
Created views for exploring sales, profit, customer performance, and monthly trends.
Added filters to make analysis more interactive.

title: HR Analytics Dashboard
summary: Power BI analysis of workforce demographics, department distribution, overtime, and job satisfaction using the IBM HR Analytics Employee Attrition Dataset.
features: Department, job role, age, and education-field views.
Years-at-company trends, overtime analysis, and monthly income by department.
Job satisfaction gauge and department summary table.

title: Finance Analytics Dashboard
summary: Power BI views of revenue, profit, customers, monthly trends, and regional performance, with year, region, category, and segment slicers.
features: Revenue, profit, order, and customer KPI views.
Monthly revenue, profit by category, revenue by region, and sales by segment.
Interactive slicers for year, region, category, and segment.
